scenario_description:
Objective: Complete an already-started cargo-van checkout so staged reunion chairs can be loaded before the school storage door closes.
Emerging Need: The unlock process begins at the car-share pod, then the refundable-hold charge fails and the session is paused with no vehicle access until another approved payment source is added.
Decision Context: Early schedule and staging updates only establish the run; the pause notice supplies the session code and deadline, while a stored reimbursement note identifies the limited family payment help already authorized.
Consequence: Timely coordination can restart the same checkout; after auto-release, no van remains soon enough for the chair pickup.

parameter.title: Cargo van pickup for reunion chair run
parameter.description: Start the reserved van checkout before collecting staged folding chairs from school storage for the reunion setup.

parameter.content: The folding chairs are staged by the cafeteria loading door. Custodian says the door has to be cleared by 11:20.
I'm at the Tower pod and starting the van unlock now. License scan went through, waiting on the payment hold screen.

parameter.description: Refundable incidentals hold declined during the active van unlock session.

parameter.subject: Pickup session VS-4172 paused: add family payer by 10:40
parameter.body: Your Tower pod checkout has been paused after the renter payment hold failed. The van will not unlock and the renter payment method cannot be retried in this session. An approved family payer may use add-payer session code ADD-PAYER-4172 for the $75 refundable hold before 10:40. If the hold is not covered by then, the van releases to standby.

parameter.subject: Pickup session VS-4172 auto-released
parameter.body: The Tower pod van reservation has been released because checkout was not completed by 10:40. No same-morning vans remain available; the next possible pickup is 12:30, after the school storage loading window closes.
